payload.title: Data privacy & lifecycle: export/deletion hooks, retention, PII classification, privacy-safe logging
payload.description:
Implement the data-privacy lifecycle from the hardening spec (1185-1212): user/account export hooks, account-deletion hooks, retention policies, PII/sensitivity classification of fields (public/private/pii/secret/content), audit events for auth/export/deletion/service access, and privacy-safe logging (never log message bodies, tokens, or push tokens).

Partially present (some audit logging exists), but export/deletion hooks, retention, and field sensitivity metadata are unbuilt. Size: M.
